title: Change of rings for presheaves of modules is left adjoint to restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, let $a:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings on $X$, let $\mathcal M$ be a presheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules and $\mathcal N$ a presheaf of $\mathcal B$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Write $\operatorname{Res}_a\mathcal N$ for the presheaf $\mathcal N$ regarded as a presheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules, $\mathcal A(U)$ acting on $\mathcal N(U)$ through $a_U:\mathcal A(U)\to\mathcal B(U)$. Let $\mathcal B\otimes_{p,\mathcal A}\mathcal M$ be the presheaf $U\mapsto\mathcal B(U)\otimes_{\mathcal A(U)}\mathcal M(U)$ (with $\mathcal B(U)$ an $\mathcal A(U)$-module through $a_U$), whose restriction map along $V\subseteq U$ sends $b\otimes m$ to $b|_V\otimes m|_V$, made a presheaf of $\mathcal B$-modules by $\mathcal B(U)$ acting on the left factor. Then sending a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal B$-modules $v:\mathcal B\otimes_{p,\mathcal A}\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ to the family $(m\mapsto v_U(1\otimes m))_U$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(\mathcal B\otimes_{p,\mathcal A}\mathcal M,\mathcal N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal M,\operatorname{Res}_a\mathcal N)$ onto the morphisms of presheaves of $\mathcal A$-modules, with inverse sending $w$ to the family $b\otimes m\mapsto b\,w_U(m)$; it is natural in $\mathcal M$ (a morphism $f:\mathcal M\to\mathcal M'$ acting on the left side by precomposition with $\mathrm{id}\otimes f$) and in $\mathcal N$.
